newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares rise in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares rise in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose on decreased turnover on Thursday on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM).
A shares -- distributed to former holders of property rights in the Beirut central district SOLIDERE is rebuilding -- rose to $105.250 from Wednesday's $105.
B shares -- issued in a $650-million subscription in January 1994 -- rose slightly to $106.375 from Wednesday's $106.25.
Turnover on BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, fell to 6,664 shares from Wednesday's 10,111 and value was $703,104.5 from $1,076,582.
There was no trade for a fourth day running on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) in any of the listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM Stock Index which covers both markets rose 0.16 percent to 908.66 and the LISPI index also rose 0.05 percent to 81.94.
